items.lede: The AI-generated Motson will appear in the game on 26 November, with the consent of his son and wife.
items.title: EA adds AI-generated John Motson to FC 27 video game

items.lede: Late broadcaster’s family allows EA Sports to create digital version of ‘Motty’ to commentate on popular FC27 First it was Val Kilmer, then Greta Garbo, but finally AI has resurrected a star the terraces can cheer for: John Motson, the BBC football pundit who died in February 2023, is coming back to commentate on the next generation of footballers –
items.title: Botty? AI helps resurrect voice of John Motson for football video game
